definitions.explanation: The act of drawing milk from a cow, goat, or other animal, by hand or by machine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{牧場|ぼくじょう}→牧場：06103_bokujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{乳搾|ちちしぼ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}した→体験する：09858_taikensuru⟧。
examples.english: I tried milking at a ranch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{牛|うし}→牛：01857_ushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{乳搾|ちちしぼ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I milk the cows every morning.
In the past milking was done by hand, but now many farms use machines.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{乳|ちち}→乳：19347_chichi⟧ (milk) + {搾|しぼ}り (squeezing, from ⟦{搾|しぼ}る→搾る：18724_shiboru⟧, to wring or press out).

- {乳搾|ちちしぼ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}する→体験する：09858_taikensuru⟧: to try milking as a hands-on experience
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧{搾|しぼ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{乳搾|ちちしぼ}り: hand-milking
- ⟦{牛|うし}→牛：01857_ushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{乳搾|ちちしぼ}り: milking a cow
